category_accuracy.note: Counted only on pairs both the gold set and the model call a contradiction. Category boundaries overlap (a changed deadline is arguably both NUMERICAL and DATE), so read this as indicative.

predictions.explanation: Statement A says 20 days of paid annual leave, while statement B says 15 days for full-time employees per calendar year.

predictions.text_b: Full-time employees receive 15 days of paid annual leave each calendar year.

predictions.text_b: All leave requests must be submitted at least 30 days in advance of the start date.

predictions.text_b: Remote work is permitted for a maximum of 3 days per week, subject to manager approval.

predictions.text_b: All new employees serve a probation period of six months.

predictions.text_b: Hotel stays in metropolitan cities are reimbursed up to 6000 rupees per night.

predictions.explanation: Statement A requires a one month notice period for resignation, statement B requires 60 days notice period.

predictions.text_b: Employees resigning must serve a notice period of 60 days.

predictions.explanation: Statement A defines leave year from 1 April to 31 March, statement B defines it from 1 January to 31 December.

predictions.text_b: The vendor agreement expires on 30 June 2026.

predictions.explanation: The two statements specify different policies with different effective dates, not conflicting values for the same policy.
predictions.text_a: This policy takes effect on 01 April 2023.
predictions.text_b: This policy takes effect on 15 February 2024.
predictions.note: Borderline by design: different documents may each have their own effective date, but as written both claim to be 'this policy'.

predictions.explanation: One policy allows carrying over unused annual leave up to 5 days, the other forbids carryover and forfeits unused leave.
predictions.text_a: Unused annual leave may be carried over to the following year, up to a maximum of 5 days.
predictions.text_b: Unused annual leave cannot be carried over and is forfeited at the end of the year.
predictions.note: One permits what the other forbids.

predictions.text_b: Alcoholic drinks may be claimed up to 500 rupees per evening meal.
predictions.note: A flat prohibition against a stated allowance.

predictions.explanation: One policy states remote work does not require prior approval, the other requires prior written approval from a manager.

predictions.text_b: Remote work is permitted only with prior written approval from a manager.
predictions.note: Directly opposed approval requirements.

predictions.text_b: International travel is approved by the employee's line manager.
predictions.note: Different approving authority for the same action.
